Alright, yeah, Graendal was always a suspect of mine. But I hardly thought it obvious; had she not been in Salidar at the time, it would have been much, much more Moggy's style to sneak into a wine cellar waiting to kill one of her adversaries. Also, all Forsaken who were not dead were still moving around at this time; it could have been anyone. We always knew it was a Forsaken; there's hardly anyone else in the current age that Asmodean would fear and know that personally. Maybe Mr. Jordan thought it obvious because Graendal had been seen earlier in Caemlyn?

As for Mesaana's death, Mr GuanYu is right. Graendal's debacle with the dreamspike caused Mesaana's demise, and this may sound terrible of me, but I think the Dark One was quite fond of Mesaana in such a sense that he found her very useful. Saerin Asnobar describes her, having looked into what historians said on her, as the kind of woman who doesn't bother getting her hands dirty; she goes in, personally, directly, forcefully; a kind of "the Shadow's Amyrlin", as Saerin puts it. Such a blunder is unforgivable. Not that the Dark One understands forgiveness, nor hope. That's why he always fails.

Nah, Sammael is definitely out. However, I suspect Demandred or Mazrim Taim for the Sammael Lookalike. They were both commanders in the Last Battle, and likely wanted to divert attention from Merrilor and Thakan'dar.
